- [.github/workflows/daily.yml:107](.github/workflows/daily.yml:107): `actions/upload-pages-artifact@v4` → `@v5` (pulls in `actions/upload-artifact@v7`)
- [.github/workflows/daily.yml:122](.github/workflows/daily.yml:122): `actions/deploy-pages@v4` → `@v5`

No other config changes needed since these are drop-in replacements (same inputs/outputs). Want me to commit this?
